user.title: Dashboard History
user.description: Records every change to your dashboards and lets you put back what disappeared. There is nothing to configure: the history starts with the first save after setup.

abort.already_configured: Dashboard History is already set up. One instance records every dashboard.

init.title: Dashboard History
init.description: A version marks a state you can come back to by name.

data.daily_versions: Mark the state at the end of each day

data_description.daily_versions: On the first change of a new day, the state that was there before it is marked as a version, named after the day it belongs to. Turn this off to keep only the versions you make yourself. Nothing is deleted either way: every state stays in the history, marked or not.
